content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for SGPGIMS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: sgpgims.org.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 04-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SGPGIMS Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Guest Faculty (Non-Nursing Subject) posts is 04-09-2026. Ensure your application reaches the institute by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Faculty (Non-Nursing Subject) position is Rs 1000/- per lecture.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Guest Faculty role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Duly recognized Post Graduate qualification with teaching experience in the respective subject to be eligible.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The official notification indicates 0 vacancies for the Guest Faculty (Non-Nursing Subject) posts, but it is advisable to check the detailed notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in-Interview, which may include an Assessment, Interview, and a Demo Lecture.

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of SGPGIMS, which is www.sgpgi.org.in.

faq.question: Q8. What is the address to send the application form?
faq.answer: The application form should be sent to The College of Nursing, 2nd floor ADC building, SGPGIMS, Lucknow, Pin 226014, U.P.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed advertisement for any age-related information.

faq.question: Q10. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Faculty (Non-Nursing Subject) posts is scheduled for 11-09-2026.
